/corecraft/garden-decor/deluxe-swing.htm.description: Families who sit out in the evening usually head for a covered swing first, and the Deluxe Swing is made for that. A wooden-slat seat for two hangs on chains from a black steel frame, with a red canopy overhead against sun and light rain. At each side the frame curves outward into low rails, which give a handhold when getting on or off. It suits society gardens, resort lawns, farmhouses and the parents' corner beside a play area. The Deluxe Swing is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range and is listed in Sand Beige. We confirm its size and warranty terms with each quote. Send us a photo of the spot and we will mark it on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/garden-decor/deluxe-swing.htm.spec_paragraph: The seat hangs on chains, so the hanging points and chain links take the wear. Check them, along with the seat fixings, at every service visit. The frame is installed self-standing on a paved base or grouted into soil, depending on your ground. Leave a clear zone in front of and behind the seat so the swing never reaches a path or wall.

/corecraft/garden-decor/luxury-swing.htm.description: The Luxury Swing is the simpler of our two canopy swings. Its slatted wooden bench hangs from a straight steel A-frame, and a red pitched canopy runs along the top bar. With splayed legs and no side rails, it has a lighter look on a small lawn or a terrace garden. Older residents, couples and parents waiting for children all use a swing like this, so it fits housing societies, hotel gardens and club lawns. It sits in our CoreCraft garden decor range with a listed colour of Sand Beige. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the quote. Tell us where you want it and we will check the clearance on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/garden-decor/luxury-swing.htm.spec_paragraph: Swing chains and their top fixings should be inspected regularly, since a worn link or loose shackle is the usual fault on any hanging seat. The A-frame legs spread wide, so we mark their footprint before deciding on self-standing or grouted installation. Oil the hanging points before the monsoon and check the canopy bolts after strong wind.

/corecraft/garden-decor/dna-pergola.html.description: Named after the twisting curve along its roof, the DNA Pergola is a walk-through garden structure. Wooden posts stand in two rows, and dark steel beams rise and fall in a wave above them, carrying wooden cross-slats that throw striped shade on the path below. It can run along a walkway, link a gate to a clubhouse or cover the route from a parking area to a play zone. For builders finishing an entrance garden, it gives the approach a clear shape. The DNA Pergola belongs to our CoreCraft garden decor range, and Sand Beige is the listed colour. Design customisation is available on request, so share your path measurements and we will send a layout drawing and a quote with warranty terms.
/corecraft/garden-decor/dna-pergola.html.spec_paragraph: The posts carry the whole roof, so each one is grouted into a footing or bolted to a firm slab, depending on the ground we find. Climbing plants can be trained up the posts, but keep them trimmed off the slats so rainwater drains. Check the beam joints and slat screws every year, and recoat exposed wood when the finish dulls.

/corecraft/garden-decor/eco-bench.html.description: Eco Bench is our plainest park bench and a sensible choice when you need many seats along a long walkway. Wooden slats form the seat and backrest, and each end rests on a black steel leg frame with straight, tapered sides. Its clean lines and lack of armrests let a row of them stand along a jogging track or against a compound wall without crowding the path. People can also sit down from either end, which helps on a busy society walkway. Eco Bench is part of CoreCraft garden decor and is offered in Sand Beige. Ask for the length and warranty terms with your quote, and tell us how many benches you need so we can space them on the layout drawing.
/corecraft/garden-decor/eco-bench.html.spec_paragraph: Each steel leg frame is fixed self-standing to a paved surface or grouted into soil, which stops the bench from being shifted. The slats are screwed to the frame, so tighten any loose screws at service visits. Keep the area under the seat swept so leaves and standing water do not sit against the legs.

/corecraft/garden-decor/grin-barrel-bin..description: Litter is the first complaint in any busy park, and a bin that is easy to spot is more likely to be used. The Grin Barrel Bin is a barrel-shaped dustbin clad in wooden slats, held at a tilt by a looping yellow steel stand. Its angled mouth faces the user, so children can drop wrappers in without reaching over a high rim. It fits a play area entrance, a school courtyard or a resort pool deck, and its slats match our benches. The Grin Barrel Bin is in our CoreCraft garden decor range with Sand Beige as the listed colour, although the stand in the photo is yellow. Capacity, size and warranty terms come with the quote, and we can place bins on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/garden-decor/grin-barrel-bin..spec_paragraph: The yellow stand is anchored to the ground, self-standing on a slab or grouted, so the barrel cannot be knocked over. Keep bins outside the safe play area of nearby equipment. Empty and rinse the barrel often during the monsoon, and check that the fixings holding the barrel to the stand stay tight.

/corecraft/garden-decor/maestro-bench.ht.description: Round, looped armrests in black steel give the Maestro Bench a more traditional look than our straight-legged benches. The seat and backrest are wooden slats, and each end frame curls into a ring that forms the armrest before opening into two curved feet. The design sits well in heritage-style campuses, temple gardens, hotel lawns and older society gardens where a very plain bench would look out of place. The armrests also help elderly users sit down and stand up. It is listed in Sand Beige within our CoreCraft garden decor range. Length, seating and warranty terms are confirmed with the quote. Share a photo of your garden and we will suggest where the benches should go.
/corecraft/garden-decor/maestro-bench.ht.spec_paragraph: Each end frame stands on two curved feet, which we fix self-standing on paving or grout into soil. Check the slat screws and the bolts joining the slats to the armrest rings during maintenance. Clear wet leaves from the slats after rain so the wood dries out quickly, and touch up any chipped paint on the steel.

/corecraft/garden-decor/pyramid-pergola..description: The Pyramid Pergola stands on four tall wooden posts and carries a stepped pyramid roof finished in wood. Just below the roof edge, a band of coloured panels in red, blue and green wraps around all four sides, which makes the structure easy to spot across a lawn. The space underneath is open, so it works as a shaded marker where paths meet, a waiting spot outside a play area or a feature on a resort lawn. It belongs to our CoreCraft garden decor range, and the listed colour is Sand Beige. The photos do not show seating, so tell us if you want benches placed underneath. We confirm size and warranty terms along with the quote and layout drawing.
/corecraft/garden-decor/pyramid-pergola..spec_paragraph: Four posts hold up a heavy roof, so on most sites we grout the Pyramid Pergola into footings after checking the ground. Inspect the roof fixings and coloured panels after the monsoon and after strong wind. Do not let children climb the posts, and recoat the exposed wood when it starts to grey.

/corecraft/garden-decor/relaxed-bench.ht.description: Seen from the side, the Relaxed Bench has a black steel frame that bends back in one sweep, setting the backrest at a reclined angle. Wooden slats form the seat and back, and the curved frame ends act as low armrests at each side. People tend to sit longer on a reclined bench, so it suits a lake edge, a viewpoint in a park or a hotel garden better than a quick stop beside a gate. It sits in the CoreCraft garden decor collection under the Sand Beige colour listing. Measurements and warranty terms come with your quote, and we can mark Relaxed Bench positions on a layout drawing alongside your other equipment.
/corecraft/garden-decor/relaxed-bench.ht.spec_paragraph: Its curved steel frame stands on four feet that we fix self-standing on paving or grout into soil. Because the backrest leans back, leave enough walking space behind it if the bench backs onto a path. At service visits, tighten the slat screws and look for chipped paint on the frame, touching it up before rust can start.

/corecraft/garden-decor/repose-gazebo.ht.description: A square wooden deck, railings on all sides and a pyramid roof make up the Repose Gazebo. The roof is wood, with coloured triangles in blue, green and yellow set into its upper part, and the front view shows an open entry between the railings. It gives a resort, school garden or society lawn a shaded sitting area that parents can use while their children play nearby. Compared with our eight-sided Comfy Gazebo, the square plan is easier to fit into a corner or along a straight boundary wall. Repose Gazebo is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range and is listed in Sand Beige. Ask for size, seating and warranty terms with your quote.
/corecraft/garden-decor/repose-gazebo.ht.spec_paragraph: The Repose Gazebo sits on its own raised deck, so the base under it must be level and drain well. We grout or fix it according to the ground and how exposed the site is to wind. Check deck boards and railing joints for loose screws, keep the floor clear of leaves and recoat the wood as part of regular upkeep.

/corecraft/garden-decor/stand-out-bench..description: The Stand Out Bench gets its name from an unusual frame. At one end the black steel frame rises well above the backrest in an angular loop, while the far end of the seat rests on a single green post. Wooden slats form the seat and back between the two. The uneven shape gives a modern campus, an IT park courtyard or a new residential project a seat that looks designed for the space. The listed colour is Sand Beige, but the photo shows a green leg, so confirm the frame colours you want. It is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range. Size and warranty terms are shared with the quote, together with a layout drawing if you need one.
/corecraft/garden-decor/stand-out-bench..spec_paragraph: With a tall frame at one end and a single post at the other, this bench has to be fixed firmly, either bolted self-standing to a slab or grouted into soil. Check both fixing points and the slat screws at service visits. Children may try to climb the tall end, so place it away from play equipment and walkway corners.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Igloo Climber is a round frame of curved grey steel arches with a rope net stretched across the top and down the sides. Four seats hang on chains inside the frame, two in green and two in yellow, so children can climb the outer net and then rest or swing underneath. It packs climbing, crawling and gentle swinging into a product area of 12'11" x 12'11", with a safe play area of 17'11" x 17'11" around it. That makes it a good single piece for a school or society corner where a group needs to stay busy. Tell us the ages of your children and we will confirm it suits them. The colour is Multi Color, and there is a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us to add it to your layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The arches are galvanised pipe and the net is play rope, both covered for 3 years. The hanging seats and chains move constantly, so check them often; under our standard terms, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year of cover. Install it self-standing or grouted, keep the 17'11" x 17'11" zone clear and lay rubber flooring under the seats.
